description: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparison of three models — RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) — across six evaluation categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG (average). The horizontal axis lists these categories, while the vertical axis represents performance scores ranging from 0 to 1.00, with tick marks at 0.50 and 1.00. Each category contains three grouped bars: dark blue for RedWhale, light blue for EEVE-Korean, and light gray for SOLAR (base). In all categories, the SOLAR model achieves a perfect score of 1.00, serving as a baseline. RedWhale scores 0.42 (PT-EVAL), 0.52 (KoBEST-BQ), 0.71 (KoBEST-CP), 0.50 (KoBEST-HS), 0.69 (KoBEST-SN), and 0.57 (AVG). EEVE-Korean scores 0.46 (PT-EVAL), 0.56 (KoBEST-BQ), 0.74 (KoBEST-CP), 0.54 (KoBEST-HS), 0.73 (KoBEST-SN), and 0.61 (AVG). The chart visually emphasizes that while both RedWhale and EEVE-Korean underperform relative to the SOLAR baseline, EEVE-Korean consistently outperforms RedWhale across all categories except PT-EVAL, where RedWhale’s 0.42 is slightly lower than EEVE’s 0.46. The bars are not sorted by height, and no additional annotations or error bars are present.
